author: Rue
title: Cover art commission for Starcaller
content: Calling all artists! I'm looking to commission some cover art for Starcaller, my queer horror dark academia story. I decided to spare the world my art skills, but idk if this reference image collage is any less harmful to perceive. Notes included: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1l_YOwf1i42DJxqTFUv_nVoo7csw6snaG3UFdIXcGZ-A/edit?usp=sharing part 2 > Follow-up: Please do not create anything before we talk! I can only afford to compensate one artist atm. If you are interested, comment and I will check out your portfolio. I will contact you if I decide I want to commission you. No hard feelings but I won't be replying to everyone. Thanks! Contact: comment on the post with portfolio.
